paper.central_claim: Meta-Harness：用一个能通过文件系统检索全部历史候选的源码、分数与执行轨迹的 agentic proposer（Claude Code + Opus-4.6）在代码空间搜索 harness，可自动做 harness 工程。作者原话：'richer access to prior experience can enable automated harness engineering'；具体声称：在线文本分类较 ACE +7.7 点且上下文 token 少 4×，数学检索 harness 在五个留出模型上平均 +4.7 点，TerminalBench-2 超过最佳手工 baseline。
paper.title: Meta-Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Model Harnesses

evidence.quote: an outer-loop system that searches over harness code for LLM applications. It uses an agentic proposer that accesses the source code, scores, and execution traces of all prior candidates through a filesystem.
evidence.support_explanation: 系统对象与核心机制：搜索对象是 harness 代码，proposer 为 agentic，看全历史。

evidence.quote: On retrieval-augmented math reasoning, a single discovered harness improves accuracy on 200 IMO-level problems by 4.7 points on average across five held-out models.
evidence.support_explanation: 摘要中的数学主张；相对基线为 No Retriever。

evidence.quote: On agentic coding, discovered harnesses surpass the best hand-engineered baselines on TerminalBench-2.
evidence.support_explanation: 摘要中 TB2 主张；§4.3 说明搜索与最终评测在同一基准上。

evidence.quote: However, these methods are poorly matched to harness engineering because they typically operate with short-horizon or heavily compressed feedback
evidence.support_explanation: 作者定位的 gap：已有文本优化器反馈压缩过度。

evidence.quote: the available context per optimization step ranges from only 100 to 30,000 tokens ( Table 1 ), far below the diagnostic footprint of harness search.
evidence.support_explanation: gap 量化：邻居每步 0.002-0.026 MTok，对比本文 10 MTok（Table 1），同时也说明本文 proposer 读取的 token 量级远大于对照。

evidence.quote: Meta-Harness Full all logs and scores 10.0 10.0
evidence.support_explanation: Table 1 末行：历史=Full、日志=全部、MTok/iter=10.0；邻居最大 0.026（TTT-Discover）。

evidence.quote: imposes no parent-selection rule: the proposer is free to inspect any prior harness and its execution trace when proposing new ones.
evidence.support_explanation: 选择规则：无父代选择规则；种群+Pareto 前沿由评测分数产生。

evidence.quote: The proposer never sees test-set results; its only feedback comes from the search set , the subset of task instances used to evaluate candidate harnesses during search
evidence.support_explanation: 信息可见性：proposer 只见搜索集与搜索期轨迹。

evidence.quote: In our experiments, each harness is a single-file Python program that modifies task-specific prompting, retrieval, memory, and orchestration logic.
evidence.support_explanation: 留存对象：单文件 Python harness（非权重）。

evidence.quote: The proposer is guided by a minimal domain-specific skill that describes where to write new harnesses, how to inspect previous harnesses and their execution traces, and what files it can and cannot modify.
evidence.support_explanation: proposer 受手写 skill 引导；skill 不在循环内被改写。

evidence.quote: In our experiments, a typical run evaluates roughly 60 harnesses over 20 iterations.
evidence.support_explanation: 典型规模；但 §4.1 为 40 个候选、§4.2 为 109 个候选，说明各域规模不同。

evidence.quote: We ran 20 evolution iterations with two candidates per iteration, producing 40 candidate harnesses.
evidence.support_explanation: 文本分类搜索预算：40 个候选。

evidence.quote: select candidates solely based on search-set performance, and hold out the test sets until the final evaluation.
evidence.support_explanation: 文本分类的选择/测试划分：候选仅按搜索集选取，测试集最后才用。

evidence.quote: we give each method the same budget of proposal harness evaluations.
evidence.support_explanation: 对照预算按评测次数匹配，而非按 proposer token 匹配（见 E005/E006）。

evidence.quote: independent samples from the seed with no search structure; a compute-matched control for whether search matters at all.
evidence.support_explanation: Best-of-N 作为无搜索结构的算力匹配对照。

evidence.quote: Text classification accuracies of the harnesses proposed by different text optimizers (search set).
evidence.support_explanation: 优化器对比表的标题明确是 search set，而非测试集。

evidence.quote: GEPA [ 1 ] 32.6 40.2 Best-of-N 34.0 44.2 OpenEvolve [ 43 ] 39.1 43.3 TTT-Discover [ 54 ] 34.1 45.6 Meta-Harness 50.0 56.7
evidence.support_explanation: 搜索集上候选的 median/best：Meta-Harness 50.0/56.7，对照最高 median 39.1、best 45.6。

evidence.quote: scores-only reaches 34.6 median and 41.3 best accuracy, while scores-plus-summary reaches 34.9 median and 38.7 best. By contrast, Meta-Harness reaches 50.0 median and 56.7 best accuracy
evidence.support_explanation: 信息接入消融（scores-only / scores+summary / 含原始 traces）：全历史原始轨迹是增益来源，单次搜索，搜索集指标。

evidence.quote: reaches 48.6% accuracy, outperforming ACE by 7.7 points and MCE by 8.6 points.
evidence.support_explanation: 测试集主结果（Table 2 平均）。

evidence.quote: uses only 11.4K context tokens, versus 50.8K for ACE and 28.5K for MCE.
evidence.support_explanation: 部署期上下文成本显著更低。
分数据集：USPTO 上 ACE(16.0) 高于 Meta-Harness(14.0)；增益主要来自 Law (45.0 vs 29.0)。

evidence.quote: The selected Meta-Harness system achieves the best average accuracy (73.1%), outperforming ACE (70.2%) and all few-shot baselines
evidence.support_explanation: 九个未参与搜索的数据集上的平均准确率；单次、无区间。

evidence.quote: We use Meta-Harness to optimize a harness for 40 iterations over a 250-problem search set of Olympiad-difficulty math problems (OlympiadBench + Omni-MATH hard), producing 109 candidate retrieval harnesses.
evidence.support_explanation: 数学检索：搜索集 250 题、109 候选。

evidence.quote: We carefully deduplicated and decontaminated it against both evaluation benchmarks and the search set
evidence.support_explanation: 检索语料已对评测集与搜索集去重去污染。

evidence.quote: report accuracy averaged over three samples per problem.
evidence.support_explanation: 数学评测协议：每题 3 次采样平均；无置信区间。

evidence.quote: outperforming BM25 retrieval by 1.3 points overall, while avoiding the regressions observed with dense retrieval and random few-shot prompting across several models.
evidence.support_explanation: 相对 BM25 仅 +1.3；BM25 本身已 +3.4（Table 6），所以 +4.7 大部分来自检索本身。
逐模型：Gem-3F 上 Meta-Harness(46.3) 低于 BM25(46.6)；平均差 1.3 点，200 题×3 采样无不确定性。

evidence.quote: For this experiment, we perform search and final evaluation on the same 89-task benchmark.
evidence.support_explanation: TB2 无留出：搜索集=评测集。

evidence.quote: the benchmark is small and expensive enough that introducing a separate split would materially weaken the search signal. We additionally check for overfitting by manual inspection and regex-based audits for task-specific string leakage into evolved harnesses.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者对 TB2 无留出的理由与唯一缓解（人工检查+regex 审计）。

evidence.quote: Meta-Harness discovers a harness achieving 76.4% pass rate, surpassing the hand-engineered Terminus-KIRA (74.7%)
evidence.support_explanation: TB2 Opus-4.6 结果：+1.7 点（89 任务≈1.5 题），对照数值来自官方榜单而非同条件重跑。

evidence.quote: Compared to Terminus-KIRA, the discovered harness gains on 7 of 89 tasks, with the largest improvements on protein-assembly and path-tracing
evidence.support_explanation: 增益只来自 89 个任务中的 7 个。

evidence.quote: both regress sharply from the 64.4% Terminus-KIRA baseline.
evidence.support_explanation: 搜索中的 Terminus-KIRA 基线为 64.4%，而 Table 7 榜单数值为 74.7%：两者差 10 点且未解释（单次运行噪声/配置差异），说明 TB2 对照口径不统一（our_inference）。

evidence.quote: however, we were unable to reproduce their reported result from the publicly available code alone
evidence.support_explanation: 未超过的榜单项 ForgeCode（81.8%）被排除理由：无法复现。

evidence.quote: The proposer reads a median of 82 files per iteration (range 69-99)
evidence.support_explanation: TB2 搜索中 proposer 实际大量读取历史。

evidence.quote: This provides qualitative evidence that filesystem access enables the proposer to inspect prior experience in enough detail to form causal hypotheses and revise the harness accordingly.
evidence.support_explanation: 机制证据为定性轨迹（附录 A），未做 agentic vs 非 agentic 的受控比较。

evidence.quote: A search run completes in a few hours of wall-clock time
evidence.support_explanation: 成本仅以墙钟时间概述，无 token/美元总账。

evidence.quote: iterating on the skill text had a larger effect on search quality than changing iteration count or population size.
evidence.support_explanation: 人工打磨 skill 是显著杠杆；其影响未被量化消融。

evidence.quote: Harnesses proposed during the search should pass this test before being fully evaluated.
evidence.support_explanation: 候选先过轻量接口验证再全量评测（Algorithm 1 'passes interface validation'）。

evidence.quote: 50-100 examples in our classification experiments, 88 problems for math retrieval
evidence.support_explanation: 附录给出的数学搜索集大小为 88 题，与 §4.2 的 250 题搜索集不一致，文中未解释（our_inference：可能指子集，需核对）。

evidence.quote: a broader study of how the effect varies across proposer agents remains for future work.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认仅测试了单一 proposer（Claude Code）。

evidence.quote: reports the Pareto frontier of non-dominated variants from the main search, all selected solely by search-set performance.
evidence.support_explanation: 文本分类的候选前沿全部按搜索集选取。

signatures.information: proposer 通过文件系统可见全部历史候选的源码、分数、执行轨迹（按需 grep/cat；TB2 搜索中中位读 82 个文件/迭代）；看不到测试集结果
signatures.operation: 检查历史 → 推断失败原因 → 提出 k 个新 harness（局部编辑到整体重写）→ 轻量接口验证 → 在搜索集评测 → 新目录落盘日志
signatures.output: population 与 accuracy-context Pareto 前沿上的 harness；最终在前沿候选上做测试集评测
signatures.conditions: 单一强 proposer；搜索集需难且小（约 50 次全量评测）；评测在 proposer 之外自动化
signatures.feedback: 搜索集分数（含上下文成本）与完整执行轨迹
signatures.selection_rule: 无父代选择规则；按搜索集分数/Pareto 保留；每文选定一个 harness 报告（文本分类为最高准确率前沿点）；无回退/回归守卫
signatures.persistence: 每个候选一个目录（代码+分数+轨迹）；最终 harness 代码（TB2 已公开）

signatures.claimed_effect: 文本分类 +7.7 点且 token 少 4×；数学 +4.7（对无检索）；TB2 76.4% (Opus-4.6)；见 E019-E030
signatures.failure_boundary: TB2 无留出；数学相对 BM25 仅 +1.3；单次搜索无方差；proposer 单一；成本未折算

signatures.object: 被发现的 harness 在部署期的行为（留存产物）
signatures.information: 文本分类：在线累积带标签样本记忆；数学：词法路由+BM25 四路检索；TB2：在 Terminus-KIRA 上加环境快照 bootstrap
signatures.operation: 分类：先草稿再检索 confirmers/challengers 验证，或 label primer+coverage+对比对；数学：路由到子领域检索策略；TB2：首轮 LLM 调用前注入环境快照

matches.tactic_steps_checked: 原卡定义：把迭代式生成过程中惯例上固定的成分（含 'conditioning granularity'）视为自由设计变量并重新设计。本文把迭代搜索中 proposer 的反馈通道（压缩分数/摘要 → 全历史原始轨迹）当作被默认固定的成分并释放；成功条件对照：点名被释放成分（是）；单一承重机制的消融使收益坍塌（Table 3：scores-only 34.6 vs 50.0 median，是）；效率收益（匹配对手所需评测 0.1×、上下文 token 4×少，是）；不重训（冻结模型，是）；理论解释（无，仅定性轨迹）。C24 子卡为扩散/流匹配等生成骨干的条件接口，对象类别不同，故子卡 null。
matches.success_failure_checks: 命中失败模式：'基线是否是最强且公平的'（优化器对比仅在搜索集、proposer token 不匹配）部分命中；'新增多模块无逐项消融'（agentic proposer、skill、Pareto、接口验证只消融了信息接入）部分命中。
matches.reason: 操作形态是 '释放被默认压缩的反馈接口'，与 conditioning-granularity 描述同构；但原卡面向生成骨干，非优化器循环，所以仅弱-中适配。

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: 在在线文本分类上，一次 Meta-Harness 搜索得到的 harness 在 3 个测试集上平均优于 ACE/MCE（48.6 vs 40.9/40.0）且部署上下文更短，并在 9 个未见数据集上平均略优；受控消融（搜索集）显示 proposer 访问原始执行轨迹是该搜索质量的关键。数学检索 harness 相对 BM25 仅约 +1.3 点，TB2 为搜索即评测的选择集结果。作者的 '自动 harness 工程由丰富经验访问使能' 总主张在跨域意义上更宽。
assessment.unresolved: 独立搜索种子方差；agentic vs 非 agentic proposer；proposer token/美元成本匹配；skill 打磨的作用；TB2 独立留出；其他 proposer。

M.reason: 机制清楚：agentic proposer + 文件系统选择性读取 + 代码空间；信息接入消融给出可区分的预测（scores-only/摘要 ≈35，轨迹 ≈50）；附录 A 展示混淆识别的定性证据；扣分：agentic 选择与全历史本身、skill 的贡献未分离，机制证据主要是定性。

X.reason: 操作链可重建（Algorithm 1、目录布局、接口验证、Pareto、选择规则、skill 作用、实现提示）；保留/回退薄：无回归守卫与回滚、无版本之外的过期/冲突处理，选定 harness 的挑选未形式化；适用与失败边界在附录 D 有说明。

E.measurement.reason: 分类/数学用标准数据集指标与去污染语料，TB2 用官方基准；Pareto 同时报告准确率与上下文成本；有 Best-of-N 与 few-shot-all 等平凡基线。扣分：数学证明类题目的评分协议仅引用先前工作；TB2 对照数值来自榜单而非同条件重跑，搜索内基线 64.4% 与榜单 74.7% 不一致；各表上下文单位（tokens vs characters）混用。

E.causality.reason: 有直接匹配中心主张的受控消融（Table 3）、同 proposer 配置同评测次数的优化器对比、Best-of-N 算力匹配对照；扣分：优化器对比仅搜索集且 proposer token 量级不匹配、agentic vs 全历史未分离、数学相对 BM25 的发现策略增量只有约 1 点而强替代（检索本身）占大头、无任何多种子重复。

E.holdout.reason: 文本分类：搜索集选择、测试集最后使用，另有 9 个 OOD 数据集；数学：新题+4 个未见模型+语料去污染。扣分：摘要中的 TB2 主张是搜索即评测（仅 regex 审计），搜索集大小口径（250 vs 88）不一致，选定 harness 只来自单次搜索。

E.statistics.reason: 报告了单次搜索内候选分布（median/best、>ZS 计数）、数学 3 次采样平均、披露了 Dense/随机 few-shot 的回归与 USPTO 不占优；但无独立搜索种子方差，无测试集置信区间，OOD 与 TB2 的 1-3 点差距在样本量下不可判定。

E.cost.reason: 部署期上下文成本报告充分（11.4K vs 50.8K/28.5K），评测次数匹配，Table 1 披露 proposer 每评测 ~10M token 数量级；但 proposer 总 token/美元、Claude Code 调用费用未给，仅称 '几小时'，对照未按 proposer 成本匹配。
